records.subject: Welcome aboard, Timber Studio
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Timber Studio* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Six days post-signup with no project, no invite, no tickets, and no reply to the welcome email [email:2839d93c] — zero engagement signals. Silent Starter accounts that haven't completed the first project by day 6 rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield?
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Following up on my welcome note last week. If it's helpful, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. And whenever you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week suit, so I can help you get that first project set up around how Timber Studio actually works? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Priya
